A '''subvocal transceiver''' was a communications device. It was used by [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] operatives such as [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcham Prace]] during the capture of [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] [[Shell (slicer)|Shell]] and [[Deke (slicer)|Deke]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
